line: Max contract, I’m a baller (Straight up)
vault_lines: Max contract, I'm a baller (Straight up)
meaning:
21 is referring to an NBA maximum contract. Under the current Collective Bargaining Agreement for the league, a player can make up to 30% of their team’s salary cap. However, if they qualify for a Supermax, that percentage climbs to 35%. If 21 is on this level, he’d be raking in more than $60 million annually!

While he may not be in the NBA, 21 Savage still really is “a baller.” He has famously played basketball against other rappers on several occasions. In fact, the Atlanta rapper actually took part in the 2023 NBA Celebrity All-Star game. He happened to score the 21st point just to make things interesting.
